repairs.analysis: Correct expansion; margin beta*(1-k/m)*(1-beta*o)>0; old product differs by (k/m)*beta^2*o*(1-beta). Public benchmark and downstream gap/D consumers valid.

Finite Borel measure differentiation yields mean Bayes identity. Under V<zH, a neighborhood of xh excludes posterior-zero mass by Bayes and a.s. best response. Support-ball average>pstar gives limit>=pstar; admissibility then forces >pstar, giving profitable deviation even at a zero-mass support point. Value zH forces unique proposal by feasibility. Both lambda0 cases covered.

Probability one on argmax, not topological support inclusion, is correct. Independent endpoint uniform-law witnesses for M and U show why wording matters; no substantive change beyond QI-05 precision.

O transporte depende da correção histórica; v2 acrescenta US-1: sob prior interior e μ_off>p*, todo assessment admissível com as premissas declaradas tem V=z_H e ambas as leis δ_xh, inclusive quando x^h poderia ser ponto de suporte de massa zero.
